summaries.text: This resolution resolves that the President be notified of the election of the Honorable Jennifer A. Hemingway as Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate.

title: A resolution notifying the President of the United States of the election of a Sergeant at Arms and Doorkeeper of the Senate.
